name: Google Journey data center campus (Haskell County)
summary: Data center campus on a 300-acre tract along Red Creek Road, south of US Highway 380 in Haskell County, Texas, owned by Homebound Group LLC. Haskell County labels the Journey abatement as a Google project, and Google named new Haskell County campuses in its November 2025 Texas program. The June 2025 county tax abatement expects Phase 1 capital costs of about $1 billion, allows up to four phases, and requires at least 50 permanent jobs. 2026 state registrations list two buildings at 1362 Red Creek Rd, JNR1A (285,282 sq ft) and JNR2A (210,420 sq ft), each estimated at $400 million, with completion targets in August and October 2027.

location.note: OpenStreetMap geometry of Red Creek Road in Haskell County. The abatement exhibit places the 300-acre tract on the west side of Red Creek Road about two miles south of US Highway 380; the registered address is 1362 Red Creek Rd, which could not be resolved to a point.
